verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm SigNoz serves an llms.txt at signoz.io/llms.txt and Markdown versions of its docs pages (e.g. /docs/introduction/.md), both returning HTTP 200 with structured content an agent can ingest. SigNoz also publishes an agent-oriented skill.md that teaches AI coding assistants to search the docs. missing for 10: independent community corroboration of agents successfully consuming llms.txt/Markdown docs in practice, documentation describing llms.txt coverage or an llms-full.txt variant

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: SigNoz publishes Agent Skills that teach AI coding assistants to work with SigNoz: search the docs
